description: Produce HWAU-only, national, state, local, and discounted valuation outputs in parallel from the same normalized activity result.
completion_policy: Complete-with-gaps means the repository now has a runtime PriceRegistry API, public NEP-backed national rows, public-safe synthetic state/local/discounted fixtures, a parallel NSW/national valuation helper, and fail-closed unavailable/blocked behavior. It does not claim complete official sourced state/local price coverage or direct valuation adapters in every surface.

implemented: runtime PriceRegistry API for national, state, local, and discounted rows
public NEP-backed national rows from shared pricing constants
public-safe synthetic state, local, discounted, missing, and blocked fixtures
parallel NSW/national valuation helper combining priced schedules
not_implemented: complete official sourced registry for every jurisdiction and year
direct valuation adapters in CLI/file, HTTP API, MCP, and OpenAI surfaces
public claim that synthetic state/local constants are official prices

gap_register.description: The PriceRegistry and NSW parallel valuation helper now expose executable public-safe valuation rows, but they remain intentionally synthetic for state/local/discounted coverage.
gap_register.rationale: Runtime behavior is implemented for public NEP rows and synthetic/local-only fixtures; official state/local source coverage remains a separate source gap.

gap_register.description: Dedicated valuation adapters are still not exposed as first-class output surfaces in the CLI/file, HTTP API, MCP, or OpenAI adapters.
gap_register.rationale: The repository proves the valuation contract at the library boundary, but surface-level parallel valuation adapters remain a follow-on concern.
